correct_completion: has the city faced such a severe economic crisis.
full_sentence: Never before in its history has the city faced such a severe economic crisis.
acceptable_variants: has the city ever endured such a severe downturn.
has the city ever faced a crisis of this magnitude.

options.text: the city has faced such a severe economic crisis.
options.why_wrong: After a fronted negative expression such as 'never before', the auxiliary must invert with the subject, so this word order is ungrammatical here.

options.text: did the city face such a severe economic crisis.
options.why_wrong: 'Did' signals a simple past event, while the stem needs the present perfect meaning of experience up to now, so the auxiliary is wrong.

options.text: has the city faced such a severe economic crisis.
the city faced such a severe economic crisis.
options.why_wrong: This is a plain past statement with no inversion, which the fronted negative phrase requires.

grammar_focus: Subject-auxiliary inversion with fronted negative time expressions and the present perfect
explanation: Fronting a negative time expression for emphasis triggers inversion of the auxiliary and the subject. Learners often keep the normal statement word order in this position, which sounds unnatural in formal English.
translation: Ніколи раніше в своїй історії місто не стикалося з такою серйозною економічною кризою.
